instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Inside a judo dojo with blue and yellow mats, the young man with short dark hair (R4) on the left and the middle-aged man (R3) on the right are locked in a judo match. The young man (R4), with his back partially turned showing 'LOPES' on his white judogi, leans forward to grip the middle-aged man's (R3) arm. The middle-aged man (R3), also in a white judogi, bends low in a defensive stance. The scene is captured with a shallow depth of field under bright indoor lighting.
